summary: Crash when a boat is destroyed by a hazard
description: What I expected to happen was...: The game functions normally after a boat is destroyed by a hazard. What actually happened was...: The server (internal/dedicated) crashes when the boat is destroyed by a hazard. Steps to Reproduce: - Ride a boat - Drive it into a hazard that destroys it
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Create or join an internal/dedicated server.
2. Spawn a boat using the `/give` command: `/give @p minecraft:boat`.
3. Ride the boat by right-clicking it and getting inside.
4. Drive the boat into a hazard that destroys it (e.g., lava, cactus, falling blocks).
5. Observe that the server crashes when the boat is destroyed by the hazard.
Observed Behavior: When the boat is destroyed by a hazard, the server (whether internal or dedicated) crashes unexpectedly instead of functioning normally as expected after the destruction of the boat. This crash occurs consistently when following the steps to reproduce: riding a boat and driving it into a hazard that destroys it. The game does not handle the event gracefully, leading to a complete server shutdown rather than continuing gameplay without interruption.
Expected Behavior: When a boat is destroyed by a hazard, the game should continue functioning normally without any crashes. The player should be able to respawn or obtain another boat and continue playing without any issues on either internal or dedicated servers.
